title: maesa mollis
intro: Maesa mollis, commonly known as the Batawi tree or Batawi, is a plant species native to tropical Asia, particularly in Malaysia and the Philippines. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and exhibiting antioxidant and antimicrobial activities, thereby providing various health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Maesa mollis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include iridoids, phenolic compounds, and triterpenoids, that contribute to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Maesa mollis have been shown to possess potential therapeutic actions, including anti-cancer, anti-diabetic, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a valuable plant for traditional medicine.
